text:
Dear Mr Gerber,

Thank you for taking my call on 11 February. As promised, here are the papers for my claim. First, your own confirmation of my notification, so we're looking at the same case number. Second, the police report from the evening of 10 February, where I also asked for the theft to be investigated.

You asked about locks and keys. My keys were all still on me that day and nothing of that kind needs replacing, so there are no lock costs in this claim.

You also asked who lives with me. Nobody: I've lived on my own at this address for three years, so it can't have been anyone from my household.

I'm also sending my policy, which shows that theft is covered, and the original receipts for the laptop and the camera with the prices I paid.

One more thing you should know. My wallet was taken too, with my credit card in it. When I noticed, around nine that evening, I phoned the card company straight away and had the card blocked. I didn't wait to speak to CSS first, and I don't think I could have: the card company told me someone had already tried to pay with it twice at a petrol station, so every minute counted.

To sum up: on Tuesday 10 February 2026 my laptop, my camera, some jewellery and the wallet were stolen from my flat at Mühleweg 78 in Stans. The total I'm claiming is CHF 7,750. If you need anything else, I'm usually reachable after five.

Kind regards,
Tara Steiner
